description: Perth and Kinross Council describes applying IESVE to its building projects, from initial design to operation. Applications include heat-loss and load calculations, HVAC sizing, orientation studies and assessment of improvements to existing buildings. The council requires contractors to supply and update building models during project delivery. It also uses iSCAN to compare operational performance and identify commissioning issues, including at a corporate-office refurbishment. The account covers a council portfolio. It does not provide a downloadable model inventory or quantified independently checked savings. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
